note: Family loop accessed by gravel road; most sites on raised gravel pads, set back ~0.5 mi from the lake. The front gate locks at closing time; a secondary entrance south of the main one on Jones Lake Drive serves the campground after hours. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 20 sites, 6 full-hookup (now 50-amp from the booking site), reservable with unreserved sites first-come (fcfs after_cutoff -> always). Changed max rig 45 -> 50 ft (every listed driveway is 50 ft except one 20-ft pull-through); added pull-throughs, drinking water, year-round, 6-month window with same-day booking, holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days. Fees ($30 non-electric incl. $3/night reservation fee; RA $27 / $42 electric for 2026) stand. Not stated: showers (only 'bathhouse'), dump station, max stay; the gravel access road and pads are not mentioned by either page (kept from the note).
